name: Mohawk Day Camp
description_short: Day camp in White Plains for ages 3 to 14 with twice daily swimming for younger campers, sports, arts, a ropes course, zip line, climbing wall and farm animals. Older campers choose part of their day, and grades 5 to 8 can add a one week overnight trip.
notes: Families can also choose any six or seven weeks. Closed Monday, July 5, 2027. Full day 9 am to 4 pm; preschool half day 9 to 12 and mini day 9 to 2:15. Extended care 7:30 am to 5:30 pm, free for families who do not use the bus. Tuition is sent on request and not posted online; it includes hot lunch and snacks, transportation, towel service, swim lessons and camp apparel. Optional overnight week at Club Getaway in Kent, CT (August 2 to 6). Staff in Training program for 15 year olds.
